cell_type.evidence: inferred: Herein, we used an antibody-based proximity labeling approach to identify SIRT3 binding to histone H3K9la and catalytic removal of the lactylationoup.

inferred: As a novel post-translational modification of histone derived from lactate, lysine lactylation (Kla) links lactate metabolism to epigenetic regulation, playing a role in modulation of gene expression in tumor and immune microenvironment.

disease_state.evidence: inferred: More importantly, SIRT3 can specifically modulate the gene transcription by regulating H3K9la, inhibiting the progression of esophageal cancer cells (ESCC).
